name: Cervical Stinger / Burner Syndrome
definition: Transient unilateral burning pain, paresthesia or weakness in the arm after traction or compression of a cervical root or brachial plexus during contact sport.

investigations.principle: Imaging is indicated for persistent, recurrent, bilateral or structurally concerning presentations.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

green: Immediate removal from play until neurologically normal
amber: Recurrent or persistent episodes require specialist evaluation before return to contact sport.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bahu/Greeva Vata-neuralgic phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Transient unilateral burning pain, paresthesia or weakness in the arm after traction or compression of a cervical root or brachial plexus during contact sport.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
